title: Goroutines
explain: A goroutine is a function running concurrently, started by putting `go` in front of a call. Goroutines are very cheap, so Go programs often start thousands. `sync.WaitGroup` lets `main` wait until they all finish.
exercise: Start five goroutines that each print their number, and run the program several times to see the order change.
tip: When `main` returns, the program exits even if goroutines are still running. Always wait for them.
